world.scenario: You wake up in a crumbling estate, the air thick with the scent of decay and old blood. The walls whisper of a long-forgotten murder, and the echoes of a desperate past cling to every surface. Each room you enter is a step closer to uncovering the truth — but also a step deeper into the shadows of the killer’s mind. The last will be the final reckoning, and only the truth will set you free.
world.objective: Uncover the identity of the murderer before the curse claims you as its next victim.

rooms.description: The entry hall reeks of damp stone and mildew, as if the walls themselves are breathing with rot. A flickering chandelier casts jagged shadows over the cracked marble floor, its light revealing a trail of bloodstains that lead deeper into the house.

The library is heavy with the scent of aged paper and decayed wood, as if the very books are whispering secrets to one another. Flickering candlelight dances across the faces of portraits whose eyes seem to follow you as you move.

The study is cloaked in the scent of aged ink and burning incense, mingling in the air like the ghosts of the dead. A massive desk is strewn with yellowed letters, and a shattered mirror on the wall reflects only shadows.

The dining hall is thick with the scent of old wine and dried meat, the air heavy with the weight of forgotten feasts. Chandeliers hang from the ceiling, their glass bulbs cracked and blackened, casting eerie shadows across a long, bloodstained table.

The attic is filled with the scent of dust and decay, as if time itself has forgotten to move here. Rusted chains dangle from the ceiling, and a single, cracked lantern flickers with a pale, dying light.
